name: Proposal for a decision
title: REPORT on the request for the waiver of the immunity of Nikos Pappas
part_text:
The European Parliament has decided to lift the legal protection (immunity) of Nikos Pappas, a Greek member of the European Parliament. Greek prosecutors asked for this because they want to take him to court over messages he allegedly sent to someone on Instagram on 11 June 2025. The complaint says he insulted and threatened that person. Parliament found no sign that the case was brought to harm his political work. Lifting immunity does not mean he is guilty; it lets the Greek case go ahead.

- **What changes:** Pappas loses his protection from prosecution in Greece, so the criminal case against him can proceed.
- **Who it affects:** Nikos Pappas, a member of the European Parliament elected in Greece, and the person who filed the complaint.
- **What happens next:** Parliament's President sends the decision to the Greek authorities, who then handle the case in court.
